description: Astro makes content pages with very little browser JavaScript by default. It can add interactive parts only where needed. Learn pages, layouts and small content lists before adding an optional interactive island. Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.
versionNote: Uses Astro component syntax, static output and client directives for interactive islands.
